site: Parcels 9 and 13, San Juan, Argentina - 1,656 km2
note_en: All eight tasks are mandatory. Each must appear in compliance_matrix.json with a status and a pointer to the section of proposal.md that answers it (the 'answers_in' heading number).
note_zh: 八项任务全部必答。每一项都要出现在 compliance_matrix.json 中，写明状态，并指向 proposal.md 中回答它的那一节（answers_in 给出的标题编号）。

tasks.title: Identity of the place
expects: A naming system for the city, its settlements and its districts
Logo direction - described and shown, not necessarily finished artwork
A visual standard: typography, colour, signage logic
expects_zh: 城市、聚落与片区的命名体系
标志方向——描述并示意即可，不要求完成稿
视觉标准：字体、色彩、标识逻辑

tasks.title: Energy and compute
expects: Siting logic for compute load relative to generation, water and inhabited fabric
Approach to hourly carbon-free energy matching, stated as a method not a slogan
Where the waste heat goes, who receives it and what it does
Grid posture: import, export, islanding - with the capacity you assumed
Every figure tagged with its evidence basis
expects_zh: 算力负荷相对发电、水源与居住的选址逻辑
逐小时零碳电力匹配的方法，写成方法而不是口号
余热去哪里、谁接收、用来做什么
与电网的关系：进口、外送、孤岛运行——以及你假设的容量
每个数字都带证据标签

tasks.title: Water in a dry place
expects: A water balance: sources in, uses, losses, returns
Cooling water intensity for the compute load, with a unit and a cooling type
Reuse loop: greywater, blackwater, condensate, brine
Landscape water logic - what is irrigated, with what, and what is not
What is curtailed first if water is 30% short, and what happens in the city as a result
expects_zh: 水平衡：来源、用途、损耗、回流
算力冷却耗水强度，带单位与冷却方式
回用回路：灰水、黑水、冷凝水、浓盐水
景观用水逻辑——哪些灌溉、用什么水、哪些不灌
可用水减少 30% 时先停什么，以及城市里因此发生什么

tasks.title: Human and machine
expects: Two movement networks: people, and machines plus goods
Every at-grade interface between them, located and counted, and how each is made safe
What machines are allowed where, and who decides: separated, mixed or time-shared
Kerb, loading, charging and storage logic
expects_zh: 两张通行网络：人；机器与货物
两者在同一平面相遇的每一个界面——定位、计数，以及如何保证安全
机器在哪里可以通行、由谁决定：分离、混行还是分时
路缘、装卸、充电与存放的逻辑

tasks.title: Programme and production
expects: Programme mix by use and approximate share
Job types and how many, with the basis stated, phase by phase
Phase one: who is actually here, and do jobs and residents reconcile
What is produced on site, and for whom - including what the agrivoltaic fields produce
expects_zh: 按用途的功能配比与大致比例
岗位类型与数量，写明依据，分期给出
一期：谁真的在这里，岗位数与常住人口对得上吗
场内生产什么、卖给谁——包括光伏农田产出什么

tasks.title: Urban form across parcels 9 and 13
tasks.title_zh: 9 号与 13 号地块的城市形态
expects: The structure of the whole site: where the five systems sit and why
The master design area you drew yourself, why it is there, and its block structure, massing and density
Public realm under desert conditions: shade, wind, water, ground surface
How the scheme uses the two parcels - parcel 9 with the Pie de Palo range and its eastern wing, parcel 13 with the lead zone
expects_zh: 整片场地的结构：五个系统落在哪里，为什么
你自己划定的总体设计范围：为什么在那里，街区结构、体量与密度
荒漠条件下的公共空间：遮荫、风、水、地面
方案如何使用两块地——带着 Pie de Palo 山地与东翼的 9 号地块，和有先行区的 13 号地块

tasks.title: Data and AI governance
expects: What data the city generates and who may read it
What is auditable by the public, through what instrument, how often, and who can check it
Who controls the compute asset, and what happens if that operator leaves
At least one named failure mode and its mitigation
expects_zh: 城市产生哪些数据、谁可以读
哪些内容公众可以审计、通过什么机制、多久一次、谁能核查
算力资产归谁控制、运营方退出时会怎样
至少一个具体的失效模式及其应对

tasks.title: Phasing in three steps
expects: Three phases defined by the scheme, drawn on the site
Phase one stands on its own: its own production, logistics and services, wherever you put it
Observable triggers for phases two and three - not dates
Decisions in phase one that cannot be changed later (at least three), and why that is acceptable
The long-term size the scheme proposes, and how many settlements
expects_zh: 由方案定义的三期，画在场地上
一期自己成立：无论放在哪里，都要有自己的生产、物流与服务
二期、三期的可观测触发条件——不是时间表
一期中此后无法更改的决定（至少三条），以及为什么可以接受
方案提出的远期规模与聚落数量
